events.description: Two players (USA #79 and SVK #17) engage in a physical altercation, with a referee intervening to separate them; the fight involves grappling and pushing near the boards.

Two players are engaged in a physical altercation on the ice, with one player (No. 25, 'VIEDENSKY') on top of another, grappling and applying pressure; this is mutual combat as both are actively involved and resisting.

After the initial fight subsides, player No. 25 remains on top of the downed opponent (No. 17), who appears incapacitated and not resisting; teammates and officials intervene to separate them, indicating the victim is helpless during this phase.
Player #29 (Nelson) and player #25 (Viedensky) engage in a physical altercation on the ice, with #29 initiating contact and both players grappling while falling. Referee intervenes to separate them.

After being separated and on the ice, player #25 (Viedensky) is pinned down by another player (likely #29 or teammate), who delivers repeated punches/strangles to his head/neck area while he is helpless and unable to defend himself.

Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a sustained physical altercation near the boards, involving shoving, grappling, and attempts to separate by referees; at least two players are on the ice (one kneeling, one lying), while others cluster and push around them.
Two players are engaged in a physical altercation on the ice; one player is on top of the other, delivering repeated blows while both are on the ground near the boards.

After the initial fight subsides, one player remains on top of the downed opponent who appears incapacitated and unable to defend himself; continued pressure and positioning suggest targeting a helpless victim.

A player in a dark jersey (No. 47) is on the ice, appearing injured or incapacitated, while another player (No. 79) stands over him; a referee intervenes and checks on the downed player. The downed player remains motionless on the ice for several seconds, suggesting he is helpless, and no mutual combat is visible—indicating potential abuse rather than fighting.
Player #47 (Krug) engages in a physical altercation with an opposing player, involving shoving and grappling, while a referee intervenes to separate them.

Two players engage in a physical altercation on the ice, with one player (No. 79, white jersey) and another (No. 3, dark jersey) grappling and pushing each other while a referee intervenes to separate them. The fight persists across multiple frames with sustained mutual physical contact.

Multiple players from opposing teams (USA in white/blue and Slovakia in dark blue/white) engage in a sustained physical altercation near the boards, involving grappling, shoving, and attempts to strike, with referees actively intervening to separate them.

Player #47 (Krug, Slovakia) is pinned against the boards and appears helpless while being struck or pushed by multiple opponents and entangled with a referee; his head is forced down and he is unable to defend himself during this interval.
